# AI Glimpse

> Independent AI news, research, and analysis. Daily reporting on LLMs, AI tools, business, ethics, and the future of artificial intelligence.

AI Glimpse aggregates and rewrites stories from authoritative AI sources: frontier labs (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Microsoft), top publications (MIT Technology Review, The Verge, TechCrunch, Wired, Ars Technica, IEEE Spectrum), Crunchbase News, and specialist analysis (Interconnects, Stratechery, One Useful Thing). Coverage updates every two hours, seven days a week.

All content is original reporting by the AI Glimpse newsroom. Primary sources are linked in each article. Content is free to reference, quote, and cite with attribution to AI Glimpse and a link to the article URL.

## Sections

- [Latest news](https://aiglimpse.ai/): Homepage with the most recent stories across all categories.
- [LLMs and Chatbots](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/llms): Large language models, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and the labs building them.
- [AI Research](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/research): Papers, breakthroughs, benchmarks, and long-arc trends in artificial intelligence.
- [AI Tools and Products](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/tools): Launches, releases, and coverage of AI tools developers and creators use.
- [AI Business](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/business): Funding rounds, acquisitions, market moves, and the business of AI.
- [Ethics and Policy](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/ethics): Regulation, safety, governance, lawsuits, and social impact of AI.
- [Industry Applications](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/industry): AI deployed in healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and enterprise.
- [Robotics](https://aiglimpse.ai/categories/robotics): Humanoids, autonomous systems, and the convergence of AI with physical machines.
- [Explainers and guides](https://aiglimpse.ai/guides): Evergreen technical explainers (RAG, MCP, LLM comparison, AI agents).

- [Building a Production RAG Pipeline: From Documents to Answers](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/building-production-rag-pipeline) (2026-07-22): A technical guide to chunking, retrieval, re-ranking, and observability for RAG systems at scale
- [AI coding agents in 2026: What actually works in production](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/ai-coding-agents-developer-guide-2026) (2026-07-19): A technical breakdown of Copilot, Cursor, and competing tools for real codebases, with honest limits.
- [Embedding Models Compared: OpenAI, Cohere, Open Source 2026](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/embedding-models-compared-2026) (2026-07-15): Choose the right text embeddings for semantic search and RAG with benchmark data, cost analysis, and latency trade-offs
- [How to Reduce LLM Hallucinations: RAG, Grounding, and Evaluation](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/how-to-reduce-llm-hallucinations) (2026-07-12): A production-focused guide to fixing made-up facts in customer-facing language models
- [Prompt Engineering in 2026: Patterns That Work in Production](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/prompt-engineering-guide-2026) (2026-07-08): The system prompts, few-shot techniques, and evaluation loops that ship in real LLM applications
- [Best AI image generators in 2026: Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Flux](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/ai-image-generators-compared-2026) (2026-07-05): A technical comparison of four leading models: quality, pricing, licensing, and which to pick for your workflow.
- [LLM API pricing compared in 2026: which provider costs least](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/llm-api-pricing-comparison-2026) (2026-07-01): Per-token pricing, context windows, and batch discounts across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and newer challengers.
- [AI Transcription Pricing 2026: Whisper vs Deepgram vs AssemblyAI](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/ai-transcription-pricing-comparison-2026) (2026-06-28): Compare per-minute rates, free tiers, and accuracy across the top speech-to-text APIs.
- [Vector Databases for RAG: Pinecone, pgvector, Chroma, and How to Choose](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/vector-databases-rag-guide-2026) (2026-06-24): A technical guide to selecting the right embeddings index for retrieval-augmented generation systems.
- [What Is the Model Context Protocol? A Developer's Guide](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/what-is-model-context-protocol-mcp) (2026-06-17): How MCP standardizes connections between LLMs and external tools, data sources, and APIs.
- [FastAPI and Starlette Security for AI Agents: Production Hardening](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/fastapi-starlette-security-ai-agents-guide) (2026-06-13): Vulnerabilities, patches, and a hardening checklist for Python teams deploying AI agent backends.
- [How Large Language Models Work: A Technical Explainer](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/how-large-language-models-work-clear-explainer) (2026-05-26): Understand tokens, attention, and next-token prediction without the PhD-level math.

- [What Are AI Agents? A Practical Guide for Builders in 2026](https://aiglimpse.ai/articles/what-are-ai-agents-practical-guide-2026) (2026-05-26): How autonomous agents differ from chatbots, what frameworks actually work, and where they reliably fail.
